operation: Inventory shader units with representation type, stages, uniforms, injection points and variant status.
required_evidence: variant capture or an explicit not_captured state
steps: Search ShaderMaterial, ShaderPass, onBeforeCompile, vertexShader and fragmentShader.
Classify each hit as complete_source, source_patch, runtime_compiled, ir or binary.
Record stages, uniforms and injection chunks, then link dependencies to materials and targets.
Leave compiled variants empty with not_captured unless a program capture actually lists them.
acceptance_checks: No patch is presented as independently compilable source.
Program totals are not distributed across units.
An empty variant list carries a reason instead of a guess.

on_failure.retry: Re-check the unresolved dependency or chunk name against the pinned file.
on_failure.stop: Stop when shader identity cannot be pinned or a capture would exceed authorization.
